prompt: Explainer visual 60 detik, diagram potongan rumah dan perjalanan air sumur ke toren dengan kontrol level, alur sebab-akibat dan zoom detail. Tanpa suara atau musik.
question: Bagaimana energi pompa membawa air sumur ke toren dan bagaimana kontrol level mengatur pengisian?
resolution: Putaran impeller memberi energi, tekanan memindahkan air, toren menyimpan, dan kontrol level menjalankan siklus ON/OFF.

references.use: Style/structure reference inspected in browser at approximately 8, 20, 35, 45 and 56 seconds; no media downloaded or copied.
Centrifugal pump: liquid enters the impeller eye and moves toward its periphery.
Illustrative tank filling control: pump starts at a lower level and stops at an upper level. The demonstration uses a level controller, not a pressure-switch claim.

limitations: Conceptual non-scaled diagram, not a pump-sizing or installation guide.
Uses a tank-level controller; does not claim all domestic systems use this control arrangement.
Illustrative tank level and flow clocks are not a calibrated fluid/pressure simulation.
